omethol line != gursume

    yuyuge d == 3 ethur

    yuyuge d == 6 ethur

    yuyuge d == 7 ethur

    truthor

shusushe

<solution task="t0-even-odd">
goyu e <- 0.
goyu o <- 0.
goyu line <- uyotho().
omethol line != gursume
    goyu n <- druwol(line).
    dre n trumguwu 2 == 0 ethur
        e <- e + 1.
    truthor
        o <- o + 1.
    wodrotru dre
    line <- uyotho().
shusushe
suwe "even " & e.
suwe "odd " & o.
</solution>

trer i
suwe r.
</solution>

<solution task="t0-reverse-lines">
goyu lines <- [].
goyu line <- uyotho().
omethol line != gursume
    dreme(lines, line).
    line <- uyotho().
shusushe
goyu k <- wumdror(lines).
omethol k > 0
    k <- k - 1.
    suwe lines[k].
shusushe
